title: Grosse Tete - Location, How to Beat & Rewards
description: The Grosse Tete optional boss in Expedition 33: both spawn locations, why you do not need to deplete its health bar, parry timing, and its reward.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content:
The Grosse Tete is an optional boss found in two separate locations. It is unusual in that you do not need to empty its health bar - it destroys itself.

It is highly resistant to damage, so this fight is almost entirely about survival and timing rather than damage output.

sections.title: The Two Grosse Tete Locations
sections.content:
1. The Continent (Coastal Cave)

It sits right in front of the Coastal Cave entrance. It can also be described as east of the large snowy island, on a smaller island with orange trees. Reaching it requires Esquie's swim ability.

2. Flying Manor

A second one is found inside the Flying Manor, in the area beneath where you fight the Dualliste. Past the broken bridge, go down using the ropes and then back up.

Note: you may see claims that this second one is missable. It is a regular boss with a regular boss title.

sections.title: Rewards
sections.content:
• Warming Up Pictos - increases your damage by 5% each turn, stacking up to five times
  • Resplendent Chroma Catalyst x1
  • 67,500 EXP

sections.title: How to Beat the Grosse Tete
sections.content:
The fight ends when it explodes

Grosse Tete attacks by bouncing. Each time it attacks, its combo gains two more bounces. It starts with two bounces, then four, then six, and so on. After the attack that reaches 24 bounces, it self-destructs - and you win.

So your goal is simply to survive 12 attacks. You never need to deal meaningful damage.

Dodge and parry timing

The bounce intervals change randomly, which makes pure reaction unreliable. The consistent read is:

  • Wait until Grosse Tete starts falling back down
  • Press dodge or parry when it is about halfway to the ground
  • Or simply parry on the sound cue

Once you lock into that rhythm, the fight becomes a long but very winnable endurance test.
